fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $30,000. Discounted fee of $25,000 applies to each Franchised Restaurant developed under an Area Development Agreement (minimum 3 units) or for existing franchisees in good standing purchasing a second or additional franchise. The initial franchise fee is nonrefundable. Under an Area Development Agreement, an additional Area Development Fee of $10,000 per committed restaurant (excluding the first) is also due at signing; $10,000 of that fee is later credited toward the $25,000 franchise fee for each subsequent Franchise Agreement, leaving a $15,000 balance due at signing of each subsequent agreement.
raw_excerpt: Our standard initial franchise fee is $30,000.  If you are developing Franchised Restaurants under an Area Development Agreement (see below), the initial franchise fee is $2 5,000 for each Franchised Restaurant developed under the Area Development Agreement.  If you are an existing franchisee in good standing who purchases a second or additional franchise, our current policy is to offer a discount so that the initial franchise fee is $25,000 for each additional Franchised Restaurant.
